title: When forgiveness keeps feeling costly as a steady practice
issueStatement: The mind knows the wound but does not know how to loosen its grip. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru links forgiveness to freedom, fearless return, and the end of inner replay. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: Forgive deeply enough that fear loses its throne. Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment.
actionPrompt: Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment. Repeat what you can actually keep.
